svg.title: Both renderers compared
svg.desc: Three panels from above: the CPU render, the GPU render, and a mask of the 259 pixels where they differ, which trace the shadow edges and nowhere else.
svg.text: The same lamps through light.hpp and scene.frag.hlsl, pixel for pixel
each pixel a known floor point; compared in linear light
of 61,043 lit pixels; every one within 1 px of a shadow edge, where the two FILTERS may differ; a 5% cone change moves 9,992
